title: TGTV: Interpretable Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection in UAV Telemetry
abstract: arXiv:2610.38106v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Anomaly detection in multivariate fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) telemetry is complicated by operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable framework for multivariate telemetry anomaly detection and traceable fault analysis that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. translated_title: TGTV：无人机遥测中可解释的多变量时间序列异常检测
translated_abstract: 固定翼无人机（UAV）多变量遥测数据的异常检测因工况转换、传感器异步采样以及可能掩盖故障特征的控制系统补偿而变得复杂。现有的时序检测方法在表示跨子系统的耦合故障、跟踪故障演化过程以及利用定量证据约束语言模型诊断方面的能力有限。本文提出了TGTV，一个面向多变量遥测异常检测和可追溯故障分析的可解释框架，它将时空图学习与大语言模型相融合。该框架采用时间卷积网络和具有加权融合邻接矩阵的图注意力网络，提取多尺度时间模式和传感器之间的空间依赖关系；随后由混合的时间Transformer和变分自编码器利用预测误差与重构概率评估窗口级异常。
tldr: 本文提出TGTV框架，将时空图学习与大语言模型相结合，实现无人机多变量遥测的可解释异常检测和可追溯故障分析。
en_tdlr: TGTV is an interpretable framework that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model for multivariate UAV telemetry anomaly detection and traceable fault analysis.
